# Quick Start Guide

**Generated by Claude Sonnet 4.5**

Two demos, one widget. Choose based on your needs:

## 🎨 Gallery Demo (Recommended for Learning)

```bash
marimo run demos/wavesurfer_gallery.py
```

**Why?** Self-contained, runs immediately, shows full implementation.

**Perfect for:**
- Learning how anywidget works
- Sharing with others
- Teaching/presentations
- Gallery submission

## ⚙️ Original Demo (Recommended for Development)

```bash
marimo run demos/wavesurfer_demo.py
```

**Why?** File upload, project integration, real audio.

**Perfect for:**
- Torah reading alignment workflow
- Testing with your own audio files
- Development work
- Project-specific features
